description: This file defines an abstract class `WriterPart` within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling ODS file writing. It manages a parent writer object and requires subclasses to implement the `write` method.

classes.name: WriterPart
classes.description: Abstract class representing a component of the ODS file writer, holding a reference to the parent ODS writer object and requiring subclasses to implement the `write` method.

methods.name: getParentWriter
methods.description: Returns the parent ODS writer object.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with an ODS writer object.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Abstract method that should be implemented by subclasses to generate the ODS content.
